entities.summary: Darryl Monroe Jr. is an American professional basketball player for the Seoul SK Knights of the Korean Basketball League (KBL). A Power Forward/Center, he played college basketball for Central Florida CC and George Mason University before playing professionally in the Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, Israel, Turkey and South Korea. Playing for Maccabi Rishon LeZion, he was named the 2016 Israeli Basketball Premier League MVP, and the 2016 Israeli Basketball Premier League Finals MVP.
